name: ARAKEL Machine Evidence Network
description: Machine-verifiable official-source evidence with free preflight and x402-paid execution on Base USDC. A2A provides discovery and routing metadata for Federal Register, OFAC sanctions, counterparty government checks, and signed evidence products.

skills.name: Federal Register Evidence Search
skills.description: Routes an agent to official Federal Register evidence search. Paid execution uses GET /v1/federal-register-search for $0.005 USDC via x402; free preflight is available before payment.
examples: Find Federal Register publications mentioning OpenAI

skills.name: OFAC Sanctions Screening
skills.description: Routes an agent to official U.S. Treasury OFAC sanctions screening. Paid execution uses GET /v1/ofac-sanctions-screening for $0.005 USDC via x402; free preflight is available before payment.
examples: Screen a company name against OFAC

skills.name: Counterparty Government Check
skills.description: Routes an agent to a multi-source government counterparty check across OFAC, FDA, USAspending, and Federal Register evidence. Paid execution uses GET /v1/counterparty-government-check for $0.03 USDC via x402.
examples: Check Acme Corp before proceeding with a transaction

skills.name: Machine Evidence Catalog
skills.description: Returns routing guidance for ARAKEL free preflight, signed evidence, batch checks, and x402-paid machine-verification products without charging the caller.
examples: What ARAKEL evidence checks can I buy?
